title: Deactivating or reactivating a term sends nothing to QuickBooks
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the test organization is connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company, and you can sign in to that company in another tab.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), already in QuickBooks' Terms list because an invoice with term A has synced.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
  3. In QuickBooks, open the Terms list (Settings, All lists, Terms).
  4. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  5. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  6. Click "Reactivate".
  7. In QuickBooks, refresh the Terms list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The toast "term A deactivated" shows.

Step 3:

  • Term A is still there, unchanged (active in QuickBooks).

Step 4:

  • Term A is listed.

Step 5:

  • The menu opens.

Step 6:

  • The term is active again.

Step 7:

  • Term A is unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
